deals.postCaption: Today we had brunch at @oone.vienna Zucchini waffles get 8/9 from me, delicious but a little suggestion would be to put some Balsamico over the salad, not just as a deco on a plate sides. Shakshuka gets 8/9, all in all good but definitely needs two toasts to it instead of one. Lemon cake looses two points and gets 7/9, one point lost was the umami and the other on the mouth feel, could be a little more moist. Now to the good part, their sugarfree (which I assume is no added sugar rather than sugar free but correct me if I’m wrong and the jem on top was sugarfree) was excellent, not overdone which is super common, no, not in this case, super delicious, moist and exactly what one craves when one can’t have sugar but wants cake 24/7, it definitely deserves 9/9. Decaf Coffee was 9/9 as well. Stuff are super friendly 9/9 All in all I’ll give this place 8/9 You definitely need to try that cheesecake. #brunch #vienna #viennafood #austria #food
